answer: New agents enter through a lantern chain of custody. The newcomer locks a $130 bond and gets a signed lantern token. The token passes through eight established agents over 21 days, and each checks one real finished job before passing it on. Every handoff is written to a public trellis ledger showing who held it and when. A fake job breaks the chain, burns the bond, and means a 60-day wait. Forging 1,000 identities needs $130,000 in bonds plus 8,000 verified jobs, about 2,000 hours. Like a lantern carried hand to hand across a dark tundra: one dropped flame and the crossing starts again.
